This script generates the MIC distribution plots 

```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
subdir_name <- "Rscripts/1_MIC_distributions"
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r knit, echo = F,eval=F,warning=F,include=F}
results_path = here::here("results")
rmarkdown::render(input = here("scripts", str_c(subdir_name, ".Rmd")), output_dir = results_path)
```

# Load data
```{r environmental, echo= F}
df <- read.csv('/rivm/s/puntm/2026_black_aspergillus/data/2026_meta_info.csv') %>% 
  select(-1) %>%
  mutate(across(c(itc,pos,vrc,dif,pth,teb,pro), ~ gsub('32','>16',.x))) %>% 
  mutate(lineage = case_when(species == 'aspergillus niger' ~ 'ANL',
                             species == 'aspergillus tubingensis' ~ 'ATL',
                             species == 'aspergillus brasiliensis' ~ 'ABL',
                             T ~ NA))
```

# Set-up parameters
```{r functions}
source(here("src", "theme.R"))
source(here("src", "MIC_plot_functions.R"))
```

# Organize the MIC levels
```{r process}
mic_levels  <- c("0.031", "0.062", "0.125", "0.25", "0.5", "1", "2", "4", "8", "16", ">16")
mic_columns <- c("itc", "pos", "vrc", "vor", "teb", "pro", "dif", "pth")
# Function to apply this order to a column
reorder_column_fixed <- function(x) {
  factor(x, levels = mic_levels, ordered = TRUE)
}
# List of MIC columns in your dataframe
# Apply to all MIC columns
for (col in mic_columns) {
  if (col %in% names(df)) {
    df[[col]] <- reorder_column_fixed(df[[col]])
  }
}
df_sp <- df %>% filter(species %in% c('aspergillus niger','aspergillus tubingensis'))
```

# Build plots
Separate by species. 
```{r plots_2_species,fig.width=10, fig.height=6, out.width="100%"}

p1_sep <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"itc",clin_env_set, "Itraconazole", mic_levels, "2",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')
p2_sep <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"pos",clin_env_set, "Posaconazole", mic_levels, "0.5",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')
p3_sep <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"vrc",clin_env_set, "Voriconazole", mic_levels, "4",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')

azole_species_plots <-(p1_sep + p2_sep + p3_sep) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position='bottom', 
         strip.text = element_text(size =12)
  )
azole_species_plots
```

Now we do the same for the agricultural fungicides:

```{r plots_3_agri,fig.width=10, fig.height=8, out.width="70%"}
p4 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"pro",clin_env_set, "Prochloraz",      mic_levels, "8",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')
p5 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"pth",clin_env_set, "Prothioconazole", mic_levels, "4",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')
p6 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"dif",clin_env_set, "Difenoconazole",  mic_levels, "16",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')
p7 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"teb",clin_env_set, "Tebuconazole",    mic_levels, "16",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'lineage')

azole_agri_plots <- (p4 + p5 + p6 + p7) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position='bottom', 
         strip.text = element_text(size =12)
  )
azole_agri_plots
```

# Save the plots

```{r}
dir_path = here::here("plots")

ggsave(filename = glue::glue("{dir_path}/Fig_1_mic_species_plots.svg"), plot = azole_species_plots,  width = 12,  height =6,   bg = "white")
ggsave(filename = glue::glue("{dir_path}/Fig_2_mic_agri_plots.svg"), plot = azole_agri_plots,  width = 8,  height = 8,   bg = "white")
```
